items.title: 52240_Frank _Machito_ Grillo oral history interview
items.q: Susie Q, Big Apple, Jitterbug, so forth, so on; so that's the only outlet we had in those years.

ctx.x: Well, they was people like they was, let's say, they improvised. They was dancers, professional dancers in their own right; so they was so creative that in everyplace, because that was the only outlet we had, dance. Like when I came here I saw the Savoy, how many dances they create at the Savoy. Susie Q, Big Apple, Jitterbug, so forth, so on; so that's the only outlet we had in those years.
So a rumbero was a fellow that danced in the streets?
